Filters map results by search keyword; 4 links in page but only 2 match 'blog'

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'map_search' => 'blog', 'max_depth' => 0, 'respect_robots_txt' => false }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.map_urls(engine, url)
puts result.urls.length.inspect
```
